m: अनु-√ शास् to rule, govern; to order; to teach, direct, advise, address; to punish, chastise, correct.
a: अनुशास् — {c2c} P. 1 (a) To advise, persuade, prevail upon, address; इति ध्रुवेच्छामनुशासती सुतां शशाक मेना न नियंतुमुद्यमात् Ku. 5. 5; पूर्वानुशिष्टां निजगाद भोज्यां R. 6. 59. (b) To direct, tell, order, enjoin; to teach, instruct (how to act); दशरथप्रभवानुशिष्टः R. 13. 75; वत्से त्वमधुनाऽनुशासनीयासि Ś. 4; राजपत्नीनियोगस्थमनुशाधि पुरीजनं Bk. 20. 17; को नु खलु मामेवमनुशास्ति V. 4 tells, directs; मघवा वनगमनाय कृतबुद्धिं भवंतमनुशास्ति V. 5 tells, directs; माणवकं धर्ममनुशास्ति Sk.; Ms. 6. 86. --2 To rule, govern. --3 To chastise, punish, correct; इयमेव तावत्प्रथममनुशासनीया Ve. 2; अरिकुलमनुशासनीयं {3}; स्वकर्म ख्यापयन्ब्रूयान्मां भवाननुशास्त्विति Ms. 11. 100, 9. 233. --4 To praise, extol. --5 To accomplish, perform, execute.

m: अनु-शासक mfn. one who governs, instructs, directs or punishes.
a: अनुशासक, --शासिन्, --शास्तृ, --शासितृ — a. One who directs, instructs, governs or punishes; कविं पुराणमनुशासितारं Bg. 8. 9 ruler; एष चोरानुशासी राजेति भयादुत्पतितः V. 4.

m: अनु-शासनीय or अनु-शास्य, mfn. to be instructed.

s: klI, (anu + SAs + BAve lyuw .) AdeSaH । AjYA । yaTA, -- “ityete brahmaRaH puttrA ASrutyAtmAnuSAsanaM” । iti SrIBAgavataM ॥ vyutpAdanaM । yaTA nAmaliNgAnuSAsanamityamaraH ॥ (upadeSaH । niyogakaraRaM । “ahiMsayEva BUtAnAM kAryyaM SreyonuSAsanam” । iti manuH .)
v: na॰ anuSizyate yATArTyena nirUpyate anu + SAsa-- BAve lyuw । yATArTyajYApane, nirUpaRe, karttavyopadeSe ca । “fRe deye pratijYAte paYcakaM Satamarhati । apahnute taddviguRaM tanmanoranuSAsanamiti” manuH anuSAsanaviroDAditi vfdDAH । karaRe lyuw । tatpratipAdake SAstre yaTA “aTa SabdAnuSAsanam” । “anuSizyante'sADuSabdeByo vivicya boDyante'neneti karaRalyuqantatayA SAstrapadena sAmAnADikaraRyamiti BAzyapradIpoddyotaH । “aTaSabdAnuSAsanaM nAma SAstramaDikftaM veditavyamiti BAzyam” । “aTa yoganuSAsAtamiti” pAtaYjalasUtram yogo'nuSizyate'nena tAdfSaM SAstramaDikftamiti tadarTaH uBayatra aTaSabdasyADikArArTaM tvAttaTAtvam “nAmaliNgAnuSAsanamityamaraH” anuSAsanaM DamAnarUpaRaM prayojanamasya Wak AnuSAsanikam । mahABAratAntargatAnuSAsanaparvvaRi ।
m: अनु-शासन n. instruction, direction, command, precept, RV. x, 32, 7, &c.
a: अनुशासनं — Advice, persuasion, direction, order, command; instruction, laying down rules or precepts; a law, rule, precept; treatment (of a subject), (with the object in comp. or with gen., the agent, if expressed, being put in the instr. or gen.); भवत्यधिक्षेप इवानुशासनं Ki. 1. 28 words of advice; तन्मनोरनुशासनं Ms. 8. 139; 6. 50; 2. 159; यौवन˚ K. 146; नामलिंग˚ laying down rules on the gender of nouns, explanation of gender &c.; शब्दानुशासनं Sk.; शब्दानामनुशासनमाचार्यस्य आचार्येण वा P. II. 3. 66 Sk. --Comp. --पर a. obedient. --पर्वन् N. of the 13th book of the Mahābhārata (so called because it lays down precepts of advice).

m: अनु-शासत् mfn. showing (the way), RV. i, 139, 4.

v: tri॰ anu + SAsa--Rini । karttavyopadeSake daRqa yitari ca “ezastenAnuSAsI rAjeti” vikra॰ ।
tri॰ anuSAsti yATArTyena karttavyamupadiSati anu + SAsa--tfc । karttavyopadeSake । striyAM NIp । ORA॰ tfn । anuSAstApi tatrArTe tri॰ striyAM NIp ।

m: अनु-शायिन् mfn. lying or extending along, Nir.
अनु-√ 1. शी cl. 2. Ā. -शेते, to sleep with, lie along or close, adhere closely to.
a: अनुशी — {c2c} A. 1 To lie or sleep with, sleep along with; lie upon, close or along; lay oneself down; to adhere to or follow closely, cling or stick to; शयानं चानुशेते हि तिष्ठंतमनुतिष्ठति . अनुधावति धावंतं कर्म पूर्वकृतं नरं .. Subhāṣita. --2 To repent, grieve for; दत्तमिष्टमपि नान्वशेत सः Śi. 14. 45; पुरानुशेते तव चंचलं मनः Ki. 8. 8.

s: klI, (anu pOnaHpunyena SIlanamaByAsaH, anu + SIli + BAve lyuw .) punaHpunaraByAsaH । muhuH sevanaM । yaTA, -- “AnukUlyena kfzRAnuSIlanaM BaktiruttamA” । iti BaktirasAmftasinDuH ॥
v: na॰ anukzaRaM SIlanaM prA॰ sa॰ । satatAByAsaM anukzaRAcaraRe “AnukUlyena kfzRAnuSIlanaM Baktiruttameti” BaktirasA॰ kfzRasyatadguRakIrttanasyAnuSIlanaM tadarTaH
m: अनु-शीलन n. constant practice or study (of a science, &c.), repeated and devoted service.
a: अनुशीलनं — Intent or assiduous application, constant pursuit or exercise, constant or repeated practice or study; विज्ञातसाराण्यनुशीलनेन Ki. 16. 28.

m: अनु-शीलय Nom. P. -शीलयति, to practise in imitation of BhP.
अनु-शीलित mfn. studied carefully, attended to.
a: अनुशीलित — a. Assiduously practised, repeatedly done, carefully attended to or studied.

v: avya॰ SIte viBa॰ avyayI॰ । SIte ityarTe, pAramuKA॰ BavAdO Yya । AnuSItyaH tadBavAdO tri॰ ।

m: अनु-√ शंस् to recite or praise after another, TS. &c.; (Ved. Inf. (dat.) अनु-शसे) to join in praising, RV. v, 50, 2.
अनु-शंस—शंसन n. subsequent recitation, TāṇḍBr., Sch.
अनु-√ शक् to be able to imitate or come up with, RV. x, 43, 5 : Desid. Caus. P. -शिक्षयति, to teach, instruct.
अनु-√ शम् to become calm after or in consequence of BhP.

s: puM, (anuSfRAti hinasti, anu + Sf + pacAdyac .) rAkzasaH । iti SabdamAlA ॥
m: अनु-शर m. (√ शॄ), N. of a Rākṣasa.
a: अनुशरः — [अनु-शृणाति, शॄ-अच्] A sort of evil spirit, Rākṣasa.

m: अनु-शस्त्र n. any subsidiary weapon or instrument, anything used in place of a regular surgical instrument (as a finger-nail), Suśr.
a: अनुशस्त्रं — [अनुगतं शस्त्रं शस्त्रार्थे प्रयुक्तं] Anything used (for the time being) instead of a regular instrument, such as a fingernail; a secondary weapon or instrument.

v: na॰ 6 ba॰ pARinIyagaRapAWokte Yiti Riti kiti ca tadDite pare dvipadayorAdyacovfdDinimittIBUte SabdasamUhe, saca gaRaH । anuSatika, anuhoqa, anusaMvaraRa, anusaMvatsara, aNgAraveRu, asihatya, asyahatya, asyaheti, baDyoga, puzkarasad, anuharat, kurukata, kurupaYcAla, udakaSudDa, ihaloka, paraloka, sarvaloka, sarvapuruza, sarvaBUti, prayoga, parastrI, (rAjapuruzAt zyaYi) sUtranaqa, AkftigaRoyam । tenABigama, aDiBUta, aDideva, caturvidyA, ityAdayo'nye'pi ।
m: अनुशतिकादि a g. of Pāṇ. vii, 3, 20, containing the compounds the derivatives of which have Vṛddhi in both parts, as आनुशातिक, &c.
अनु-शतिक mfn. accompanied with or bought for a hundred.
a: अनुशतिक — a. Accompanied with, or bought for, a hundred; ˚आदिः a class of words or गण mentioned in P. VII. 3. 20, where both members undergo Vṛddhi.

m: अनुशयाक्षेप m. (in rhet.) objection expressing (or resulting from) repenting, Kāvyād. ii, 162.

v: strI anu + SINa--SAnatt । parakIyanAyikABede । tadvivaraRaM nAyikASabde dfSyam । anutApakarttari tri॰ ।
m: अनु-शयाना f. a heroine or female character who regrets the loss of her lover (in dramas).

a: अनुशयान — a. Regretting &c. --ना A variety of heroine (परकीयनायिकाभेदः); one who is sad and dejected, being apprehensive of the loss of her lover (इष्टहानिजनितानुतापवती).

s: strI, (anuSayyate anutapyate'nayA, anu + SI + ac, gOrAditvAt NIz .) kzudrarogAntargatapAdarogaviSezaH । tasya lakzaRaM । yaTA, -- “gamBIrAmalpasaMramBAM savarRAmuparisTitAM । pAdasyAnuSayIM tAntu vidyAdantaHprapAkinIM” ॥ iti mADavakaraH ॥ taccikitsA yaTA, -- “haredanuSayIM vEdyaH kriyayA SlezmavidraDeH” । iti BAvaprakASaH ॥

v: strI anuSayyate paScAttapyate'syAm । anu + SINaDikaraRe ac gOrA॰ NIz । pAdarogaBede, “haredanuSayIM vEdyaH kriyayA SlezmavidraDeriti” BAvaprakASaH ।
m: अनु-शयी f. a disease of the feet, a boil or abscess on the upper part

s: puM, (anu + SI + BAve ac, SayaM hastamanugataH prAdisamAsaH, hastAnugate tri .) dIrGadvezaH । pUrvvavEratA । anutApaH । ityamaraH । (“anuSayAdanurodimi cotsukaH” । “anuSayaduHKAyedaM hatahfdayaM samprati vibudDam” । iti SAkuntale .) dvezaH । anubanDaH । iti medinI ॥ (kroDaH । paScAttApAdikAraRAt vipratipattiH । yaTA, -- “krayavikrayAnuSayo vivAdaH svAmipAlayoH” । iti manuH .)
v: pu॰ anu + SIN--ac । atyantadveze, paScAttApe, pUrbavEre ca । anugataH SayaM hastaM gatisa॰ hastAnugate tri॰ । tatra krItAdipadArTaviSezeRAnuSayasvarUpAdi nAradenoktam । “krItvA mUlyena yaH paRyaM kretA na bahu manyate । krItAnuSaya ityetadDivAdapadamucyate” । tatra ca yasminnahani paRyaM krItantasminnevAhni tadavikftaM pratyarpaRIyamiti tenEvoktam । “krItvA mUlyena yat paRyaM duHkrItaM manyate krayI । vikretuH pratideyantattasminnevAhnyavikzatamiti” । dvitIyAdidine tu pratyarpaRe viSezastenEvoktaH । “dvitIye'hni dadat kretA mUlyAttriMSAMSamAharet । dviguRantu tftIye'hni parataH kretureva taditi” । parato'nuSayo na karttavya ityarTaH । etacca vIjAdivyatiriktopaBogAdivinaSvaravastuvizayam । vIjAdikraye punaranya eva pratyarpaRe'vaDirityAha । “daSEkapaYcasaptAhamAsatryahArdDamAsikam । vIjAyovAhyaratnastrI dohyapuMsAM parIkzaRam” । vIjaM vrIhyAdivIjam । ayo lOham । vAhyo balIvarddAdiH । ratnaM muktAprabAlAdi । strIMdAsI । dohyaM mahizyAdi । pumAn dAsaH । ezAM vIjAdInAM yaTAkrameRa daSAhAdekaH parIkzAkAlo vijYeyaH । parIkzyamARe ca vIjAdO yadyasamyagbudDyA'nuSayo Bavati tadA daSAhAByantara eva krayanivfkziH । na punarUrdDvamityupadeSaprayojanam । yattu manuvacanam । “krItvA vikrIya vA kiYcit yasyehAnuSayo Bavet । so'ntardaSAhAt taddravyaM dadyAccEvAdadIta veti” । taduktalohAdivyatiriktopaBogAdivinaSvaragfhakzetrayAnaSayanAsanAdivizayam । sarvaYcEtadaparIkzitakrItavizayam । yat punaH parIkzitanna punaH pratyarpaRIyamiti samayaM kftvA krItaM taddiketre na pratyarpaRIyam taduktam । “kretA paRyaM parIkzeta prAk svayaM guRadozataH । parIkzyABimataM krItaM vikreturna Bavet punariti” mitA॰ । tataSca krItasya, vikrItasya, anyaTA vA kftasya vastunaH, asamIcInatvabudDyA yaH paScAttApaH so'nuSaya iti boDyam । “BuktakarmmaRo'vaSeze ca “kftAtyaye'nuSayavAn dfzwasmftiByAM yaTetamanevamiti” SA॰ sU॰ svargArTakarmmaRo BuktaPalasyAvaSezaH kaScidanuSayo nAma BARqAnusArisnehavat yaTA hi snehaBARqaM viricyamAnaM na sarvAtmanA viricyate BARqAnusAryyeva kaScit snehaSezo'vatizWate taTAnuSayo'pIti” BA॰ । “tatra dfzwaM pratyakzaM SrutiH sA hi sAnuSayAnAmevAvarohaM darSayati yaTA “tadya iha ramaRI caraRA aByAsoha yatte ramaRIyAM yonimApadyeran brAhmaRayoniM vA kzatiyayoniM vA vESyayoniM vA aTa ya iha kapUyacaraRA aByAsoha yatte kapUyAM yonimApadyeran SvayoniM vA SUkarayoniM cARqAlayoniM veti” । caraRaSabde nAnuSayaH (SezaH) sUcyate । dfzwaScAyaM janmanEva prARyuccAvacarUpOpaBogaH gaviBajyamAna AkasmikatvAsamBavAt anuSayasaqAyaM sUcayati aByudayapratyavAyayoH sukftadupkftahetukatvasya sAmAnyataH SAstreRAvagamitatvAditi ca SA॰ BA॰ ।
m: अनु-शय m. close connection as with a consequence, close attachment to any object
(in phil.) the consequence or result of an act (which clings to it and causes the soul after enjoying the temporary freedom from transmigration to enter other bodies)
a: अनुशय, --शयिन् — &c. See under अनुशी.

अनुशयः — [शी-अच्] 1 Repentance, remorse; regret, sorrow; नन्वनुशयस्थानमेतत् Māl. 8; कुतस्तेऽनुशयः M. 3 why should you be sorry; बाष्पं प्रमृज्य विगतानुशयो भवेयं Ś. 7. 25; इतो गतस्यानुशयो मा भूदिति V. 4; Śi. 2. 14. --2 Intense enmity or anger; शिशुपालोऽनुशयं परं गतः Śi. 16. 2; यस्मिन्नमुक्तानुशया सदैव जागर्ति भुजंगी Māl. 6. 1. --3 Hatred. --4 Close connection, as with a consequence; close attachment (to any object). --5 (In Vedānta phil.) The result or consequence of bad deeds which very closely clings to them and makes the soul enter other bodies after enjoying temporary freedom from recurring births; (स्वर्गार्थकर्मणो भुक्तफलस्य अवशेषः कश्चिदनुशयो नाम भांडानुसारिस्नेहवत्, यथा हि स्नेहभांडं विरिच्यर्मानं सर्वात्मना न विरिच्यते भांडानुसार्येव केश्चित् स्नेहशेषो ऽ वतिष्ठते तथानुशयोऽपि Tv.). --6 Regret in the case of purchases, technically called rescission; Ms. 8. 222; see क्रीतानुशय. --यी A disease of the feet, a sort of boil or abscess on the upper part.

v: pu॰ anu + SIN--ini । yAvatkarmakzayaM candraloke sTitvA sAvaSeze eva karmmaRi paScAttApAnvitatayA BUmiloke janmagrahaRAyAgantuM pravftte jIve । “yo yI hyannamatti anuSayiBiH tadaMSena BAvitatvAt saMskftatvAcca saMSlizwaretaHsigiti” CA॰ BA॰ । tasya retaHsigAkftyAH pUrvvasammUtatvAt tadrUpeRa garBASayamanupravizwo'nuSayI retaHsigAkftirBavatIti Ananda॰ । paScAttApayute tri॰ । puRzasya anuSayata eva BuktaBogAyAH prakftestyAgaH SrutAvapyuktaH । “ajAmekAM lohitaSaklakfzRAM bahvIH prajAH sfjamAnAM svarUpAH । ajohyeko juzamARo'nuSete jarAtyenAM BuktaBogAmajo'nya iti “yaM saMpadya jahAtyajAmanuSayI suptaH kulAyaM yaTeti” BAga॰ ।
m: अनु-शयिन् mfn. having the consequence of an act, connected as with a consequence
a: अनुशयिन् — a. 1 Devotedly attached to, faithful. --2 Repentant, penitent, regretful, sorry. --3 Hating intensely. --4 Connected as with a consequence. --5 Enjoying the fruits of deeds; epithet of the soul.

m: अनु-शिख m. N. of a Nāga or snake priest, PBr.
अनु-शिशु f. followed by its young (as by a foal, &c.), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
a: अनुशिशुः — f. [अनुगता शिशुना] An animal followed by its young one.

m: अनु-शिक्षा f. learning or striving after, Jātakam.
अनु-शिक्षिन् mfn. exercising one's self in, practising, Daś. &c.
a: अनुशिक्षिन् — a. Practising, learning.

v: tri॰ anu + SAsa--karmmaRi kta । kftAnuSAsane, yasya hitopadeSaH kriyate tasmin, daRqite ca ।

a: अनुशिष्टिः — f. Instruction, teaching; order, command.

m: अनु-शिष्य ind.p. having ruled or ordered.

v: na॰ anuSlokyate gIyate anu + Sloka--karmmaRi ac । mahAvrate geye sAmaBede, “Slokena stuvate purastAt sadasaH, anuSlokena paScAditi” tA॰ brA॰ । tacca vegAnagranTe 112 prapA॰ Adyam sAsa ।
m: अनु-श्लोक m. N. of a Sāman, TS.
a: अनुश्लोकं — [अनुश्लोक्यते गीयते, श्लोक्, कर्मणि अच्] A kind of Sāma (महाव्रतगेयः सामभेदः).

m: अनु-शोचक mfn. grieving, one who repents
a: अनुशोचक --शोचिन् — a. 1 Regretful, penitent. --2 Causing regret.

v: tri॰ anuSucyate anu + Suca--karmmaRi anIyar । anuSocanArhe yamuddiSya Soka kriyate tasmin ।

m: अनु-शोक m. sorrow, repentance, regret, L.
a: अनुशोकः, --शोचनं — Sorrow, repentance, regret; अनुशु (शो) चितं in the same sense.

m: अनु-√ श्रथ् cl. 6. P. -शृन्थति, to untie, TS. : Caus. P. (aor. Subj. 2. sg. -शिश्रथः) to frighten [BR.; ‘to abolish’, Sāy.], RV. iv, 32, 22 : Ā. -श्रथयते, to annihilate or soften the effect of RV. v, 59, 1.
अनु-श्रव m. Vedic tradition (acquired by repeated hearing), L.
a: अनुश्रवः — Vedic or sacred tradition.

m: अनु-˚श्रोतव्य mfn. to be heard, Suśr.
अनु-√ श्रु cl. 5. P. -शृणोति, to hear repeatedly (especially what is handed down in the Veda) : Desid. Ā. -शुश्रूषते, to obey.
a: अनुश्रु — {c5c} P. 1 To hear (= श्रु); नानुशुश्रुमजात्वेतत् Ms. 9. 100; तद्यथानुश्रूयते Pt. 1 heard, related. --2 To hear repeatedly as from a sacred authority, hand down as by Vedic tradition.

m: अनु-श्रुत mfn. handed down by Vedic tradition.
अनु-√ 1. शुच् to mourn over, regret, bewail: Caus. P. -शोचयति, to mourn over.
a: अनुशुच् — {c1c} P. To bewail, mourn over, regret; कथं तमेव चौरहतकमनुशोचसि Mk. 3; नष्टं मृतमतिक्रांतं नानुशोचंति पंडिताः Pt. 1. 333; शैशवं ते स्मृत्वात्मानमनुशोचामि K. 333; Ve. 5. 4 condole with, weep with. --Caus. To mourn over, deplore, grieve for, regret; तृणमिव वने शून्ये त्यक्ता न वाप्यनुशोचिता U. 3. 32 nor was she (her loss) regretted.
अनुशुचिका — A ceremony enjoined by the Vedas (?).

m: अनु-√ शुष् to dry up gradually, ŚBr. &c.; to become emaciated by gradual practice of religious austerity, Kauś.; to languish after another.
